LESSON: JUDGE DEBORAH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible: Selected Teachings
Topic 2.2: Judge Deborah

• Today’s class: Judge Deborah
